{{Quote|She is blood of the Clan Vos, like myself, and so are all her extended family. Of course you are welcome. Please inform me when the project is completed. Sheyf Zharia Vos out.|Zharia Vos, speaking to "Bantha" Rawk about his wife Droo|<ref name="Legacy 34" />}}
'''Zharia Vos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] who led the [[Kiffu Guardians]] as the [[Sheyf]] of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] and [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]]. In [[137 ABY]], Vos allowed former Guardian [[Droo Rawk]] and her family to settle on Kiffex, and soon after contracted Droo's husband, [[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]], to create a suit of life-preserving [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for the Guardians to use. The Rawks ultimately placed the mortally wounded [[Imperial Knight]] [[Azlyn Rae]] inside the suit while healing her at the behest of their nephew, [[Cade Skywalker]]. Rae sought refuge at Vos's [[Sheyf's Palace|palace]] for two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before returning [[Bastion/Legends|home]]. When [[Imperial Agent|agents]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] expressed interest in using Kiffex or Kiffu as an Imperial base, Vos began to take precautions and asked Droo to return to the Guardians as a [[General/Legends|general]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Your work is impressive, Rawk. Timely as well. I did not expect such quick results.''"<br />"''Ah, I'd already been foolin' around with some things like it. 'Sides, we owe you for allowing me and my family to move here to Kiffex.|Zharia Vos and "Bantha" Rawk discuss a prototype suit of life-preserving armor|<ref name="Legacy 34" />}}
Zharia Vos, a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Legacy 37 letters" /> [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]],<ref name="making of a comic" /> was born into [[Clan Vos]],<ref name="Legacy 34" /> one of the largest clans on Kiffex.<ref name="Legacy 37 letters" /> Living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]],<ref name="Legacy 35" /> Vos had ascended to the position of [[Sheyf]],<ref name="Legacy 34" /> the leader of the [[Kiffu Guardians]] and the ruler of Kiffex and [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]],<ref name="Republic 20">[[Star Wars (1998) 20|''Star Wars'' (1998) 20]]</ref><ref name="Republic 32">[[Star Wars (1998) 32|''Star Wars'' (1998) 32]]</ref> by [[137 ABY]],<ref name="Legacy 34" /> and resided in the [[Sheyf's Palace]] on Kiffex. Under Vos' leadership,<ref name="Legacy 35" /> the Kiffu Guardians remained neutral during the war.<ref name="Legacy War 2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref>

During the war, [[Droo Rawk]] of Clan Vos<ref name="Legacy 34" /> and her children had run-ins with agents of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] at their [[Rawk's Nest|home]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]],<ref name="Legacy 24">[[Legacy (2006) 24|''Legacy'' (2006) 24]]</ref> and learned that they were endangered by the Empire's search for [[Cade Skywalker]], the nephew of Droo's [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]]. The family decided to move for their safety<ref name="Legacy 25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> and Zharia Vos welcomed them to settle on Kiffex. As Bantha was an apt [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], Vos requested that he develop a suit of life-preserving [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for the Kiffu Guardians. At his family's new [[Rawk compound|compound]], he constructed a prototype suit<ref name="Legacy 34" /> that pumped [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] around and breathed for the wearer.<ref name="Legacy 35" /> When the project neared completion, he spoke with Vos via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and reported on his progress. Vos thanked and congratulated him before signing off.<ref name="Legacy 34" />

Skywalker brought his mortally [[Battle on Had Abbadon|wounded]] friend, the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Azlyn Rae]], to demand that the Rawks heal her while misleading them about Rae's own wishes; she had accepted [[Death/Legends|death]] and subsequently resisted all of Droo's [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] efforts. Upon regaining consciousness, Rae discovered that Bantha and Droo had placed her inside the prototype suit of life-preserving armor<ref name="Legacy 34" /> and was furious with her predicament. She left the compound to seek refuge at the Sheyf's Palace, where Vos received her as a guest for the next two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] until Imperial Knight [[Ganner Krieg]] arrived there in search of Rae. Vos directed Krieg to her, and the Knights then left together for the [[Empire-in-exile]]'s [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Legacy 35" />

In [[138 ABY]], during [[Darth Krayt]]'s renewed military push against his enemies, [[Imperial Agent|Agents]] of his Empire contacted the Kiffu Guardians and requested that an Imperial base be built on Kiffex or Kiffu, but their request was denied.<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> As a precaution against possible actions by Krayt's forces, Sheyf Vos contacted Droo and requested that she reactivate her [[General/Legends|general's]] commission within the Kiffu Guardians.<ref name="Legacy War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|She's in here.''"<br />"''My thanks, Sheyf Zharia.|Vos directs Ganner Krieg to Azlyn Rae|<ref name="Legacy 34" />}}
[[File:Welcometokiffex.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Vos personally welcomes Ganner Krieg to her palace.]]
Vos had long [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] styled in twists,<ref name="Legacy 34" /> dark brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light brown skin.<ref name="Legacy 35" /> As a member of Clan Vos, Zharia Vos sported<ref name="Legacy 34" /> the traditional Kiffar ''qukuuf'' facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] that were applied at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of a Kiffar's birth.<ref name="Legacy 34" /><ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> Zharia was kind to and respectful of other members of Clan Vos, as well as to their extended families, welcoming clanmate Droo Rawk and her family to see sanctuary on Kiffex. The Sheyf was also mindful that Droo's [[Droo's husband|first husband]] was a Kiffu Guardian who had died in their service.<ref name="Legacy 34" />

Sheyf Vos later welcomed the physically and emotionally exhausted Azlyn Rae as a guest at the Sheyf's Palace.<ref name="Legacy 35" /> After contracting "Bantha" Rawk to design a suit of armor for the Kiffu Guardians, Vos praised him for his good work and his haste.<ref name="Legacy 34" /> Despite being Sheyf, Vos personally interacted with both Rawk and Ganner Krieg rather than dealing with them through an intermediary.<ref name="Legacy 34" /><ref name="Legacy 35" /> While war ravaged [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> Vos<ref name="Legacy 34" /> kept the Kiffu Guardians a neutral force<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> but took necessary steps to prepare them for a possible attack by Darth Krayt's forces.<ref name="Legacy War 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|NOTE: no, the Sheyf is NOT related directly to Quin but we've established that Clan Vos has held the Sheyf position and this just keeps the continuity.|John Ostrander, in the script of ''Star Wars: Legacy 34: Storms, Part 1''|<ref name="making of a comic" />}}
Zharia Vos appeared in the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Storms|''Storms'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', which was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and released in [[2009]].<ref name="Legacy 34" /><ref name="Legacy 35" /> Ostrander and Duursema had previously written a number of comics about the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], a Kiffar member of Clan Vos<ref name="Twilight">''[[Star Wars: Twilight]]''</ref><ref name="Darkness">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref><ref name="Dreadnaughts">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref><ref name="The Hidden Enemy">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''</ref> and a fan-favorite [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] character.<ref name="Hunt for Ziro Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}</ref><ref name="examiner">{{WebCite|url=http://www.examiner.com/star-wars-in-national/exclusive-preview-of-quinlan-vos-on-next-weeks-clone-wars|text=Exclusive preview of Quinlan Vos on next weeks Clone Wars|work=Examiner.com|archivedate=20101108043303}}</ref><ref name="toy">{{WebCite|url=http://www.galactichunter.com/gh/story/image-bank-cw36-quinlan-vos|text=Image Bank: CW36 Quinlan Vos|work=Galactic Hunter|nobackup=1}}</ref> Their intent, which they established in the script of the [[Legacy (2006) 34|first issue]] of ''Storms'',<ref name="making of a comic" /> was that Zharia was not a direct descendant of Quinlan.<ref name="Legacy 37 letters" /> Zharia Vos was conceived because Ostrander and Duursema had earlier established that Clan Vos held the Sheyf position and therefore wanted to keep a solid [[Canon|continuity]].<ref name="making of a comic" />
